messages:
Ana P: Quick check — following INC-834 postmortem, I sketched owners/due dates for action items. Can folks confirm or reassign? Table below.

Trevor L: sending now, thanks.

Ana P: Actions I have: 
1) Increase autoscale buffer for low-latency routes -> owner: Trevor L -> due: 2026-03-28 -> PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4212
2) Add KV-cache miss-rate alert and dashboard -> owner: Margo -> due: 2026-03-25 -> Jira: INF-998
3) Postmortem doc + timeline cleanup (add logs/latency graphs) -> owner: Samir -> due: 2026-03-24 -> NOTE: include span IDs
4) Private deployment rollback test (canary fallback) -> owner: Ana P -> due: 2026-04-02 -> runbook link: https://docs.internal/playbooks/fallbacks
5) Follow-up with customer success re: SLA impacts -> owner: Trevor L -> due: 2026-03-30

Trevor L: I can take 1 & 5. For #1 planning to bump buffer from 20% -> 35%, will do a canary during low-traffic window.

Margo: ack INF-998. I'll add a panel for kv_cache.miss_rate and a PagerDuty rule if > 5% for 5m. Due 3/25 works.

Samir: I will update the doc and attach the query snippets; can we add the specific trace IDs? Ana, do you have the list?

Ana P: @Samir yes — putting trace IDs + raw latency CSV in the shared folder now: https://drive.internal/ss/INC-834-artifacts

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary window 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC (auto muted).

Trevor L: Quick Q: for the autoscale change, do we want to tie the config to route tagging or global pool? I prefer route-specific to avoid global waste. cc @Margo

Margo: route-specific sounds right. Also add a short test plan so SRE can validate after deploy.

Ana P: Agreed. Trevor, please add a one-paragraph test plan to the PR and tag "eng-sre".

Trevor L: Will do — PR updated with test plan and canary steps. @Margo can you watch the canary and confirm?

Margo: I can monitor. If miss_rate rises >2% roll back immediately.

Samir: Added timeline and the query snippets to the postmortem doc. I put a short note about regression detection thresholds. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/187

Ana P: Thanks all. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: once they have ownership sorted and the due date is realistic? I will batch these into the RCA closure ticket.

Trevor L: :white_check_mark:

Margo: :white_check_mark:

Samir: :white_check_mark: I might move to 3/26 if we find more traces, will update if so.

Ana P: Noted. If any change to scope/dates, update the RCA ticket (INF-RCA-834) and ping me. Closing the loop on timeline by 2026-03-19 COB.

Trevor L: Ping — I've assigned the PR reviewers (eng-runtime, eng-sre). Will coordinate follow-up in the PR thread.

Margo: I'll add the dashboard link to the RCA once panels are up.

Ana P: Great. I'll do a final sweep Friday morning and mark actions as "in progress" in the tracker. Thanks everyone.
